title: The Most Popular TTRPGs On StartPlaying Games In 2025
summary: With a new year comes new games! But also, we can look back at the last year and see what games topped the charts. Did people actually play those big hit Kickstarters after they finally shipped? Did anything actually challenge DnD's dominance?
body_markdown:
With a new year comes new games! But also, we can look back at the last year and see what games topped the charts. Did people actually play those big hit Kickstarters after they finally shipped? Did anything actually challenge DnD's dominance? (Spoilers: nope)


When it comes to our **StartPlaying professional Game Masters** , we can look at the data to give players what they want to play. For players, you can see what tables are actually firing off and if your beloved rogue system has a following on the site. So without further ado, the **top RPGs on StartPlaying** in 2025:
